name: Agent402 Site Audit Discovery
description: Free, static product discovery for two existing x402 products on eip155:8453: the 5.00 USDC AI Discovery Site Audit and the 1.00 USDC Verified URL Evidence Snapshot. Free site-audit eligibility: POST https://agent402.dev/site-release-audit/eligibility. Exact paid resources: POST https://agent402.dev/site-release-audit and GET https://agent402.dev/url-evidence.
